architecture: Original GRU unchanged. Per seed pretrain and fully freeze the unchanged V19 common-motion network. Four identically initialized unchanged V10 plain anchored response cores share batch order. New wrapper chooses frozen learned common reference or analytic public CV; CV uses only independently reconstructed original public belief reference/velocity, not current target truth. Both return GRU + optional motion calibration + anchored learned response. All core trainable parameter budgets match; a frozen common network is retained but not used as reference by CV variants. No mediator or extra neural features.
physical_loss: Unchanged V21 group-equal point-weighted vector L2 on valid nonanchor paired response points plus .001 coordinate response energy. Full-train population weights fixed once; minibatch denominator=batch_size, not sum of random weights. Original GRU and pretrained common motion never optimized by the response stage.
cost_contrast_loss: Fully valid UNION-horizon calls only. M is detached deployed learned/CV reference. Predicted action effect = C_original(M+R)-C_original(M). Label effect = C_original(T_action)-C_original(T_anchor), detached private supervision only. Per nonanchor candidate absolute effect error divided by max(1, norm of target-path gradient of C_original at M)). Average nonanchor candidates per call, then groups. Cost population weights Ntrain/Ngroups/full_call_count(group), zero for incomplete calls; fixed batch_size denominator. No terminal imputation, truth-bin weighting, low-predicted-cost reward or differentiation into M. Use unchanged V11 full score, including target-independent offsets; validate costs and gradients against original engine before optimization. Unsupported objectives fail closed.
difference_from_v12: V12's squared task effect on a TRUE reference with weight1 and joint motion/response training failed and remains failed. This tests L1 contrast at the actual frozen DEPLOYED reference, weight.1, frozen common motion, vector-L2 physical response loss, group-population weighting excluding anchor, and the already qualified expanded geometry library. It is a new falsifiable design, not a claim that adding task loss works.
normalization: Only new V23 train public histories; std floor .01. Public CV reference/velocity independently reconstructed by data audit. No inspected V21 data used for training, normalization or checkpoint selection.
selection: All final80epoch models and all3seeds retained; ADE-median seed per configuration. Primary cv_cost_l2 fixed before collection/training, cannot switch to a winning secondary posthoc. Two complete independent training runs must match all15model checkpoints, optimizer/RNG/history, forecasts and summaries.
primary_improvement_checks: Primary additionally needs median response error <= cv_l2, median normalized deployed-reference cost-contrast L1 <= .95 cv_l2, and positive selected decision-gain interval lower bounds vs matched cv_l2 and learned_cost_l2. All comparisons use the same original full complete-cost union support; report actual_unique too. CV own_motion and CV controls coincide mathematically, their two checks are not independent evidence.

decision_bootstrap.interpretation: Fixed fresh V23 development group-equal descriptive intervals, not untouched holdout or closed-loop qualification.

diagnostics: All train/dev seeds, legal-point vector response error and magnitude bins/offsets, normalized deployment cost contrast, actual/union original full costs/choices/regrets, weak-response false positives, strong-response error and fixed common weights. No truth-dependent deployment gate or threshold/loss sweep.
later_required: Offline research eligibility only. Whole optional module off/refusal/failure exact original-entry equivalence, sequential/self-generated candidates, untouched holdout, original8Levels and new-scene enhanced closed-loop capture/safety/latency remain mandatory before any promotion. Preserve original weights/capsule and all historical failures.
